newsitem.title: USA: TABLE - Paxson Q2 net, shr rise on gain.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - Paxson Q2 net, shr rise on gain.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTES: In Q2 the company announced its agreement to sell its radio division to Clear Channel Communications Corp.

Net income of $42.5 million in Q2 included gain of $52.2 million from sale of the company's interest in WPBF TV-25, its ABC affiliated television station in West Palm Beach. The company entered an agreement to sell WPBF TV-25 to Hearst Corp on March 26, 1997. In Q2 the company sold this station to the company's principal shareholder for the same price, in order to accelerate receipt of consideration from this station's sale.
The 1996 Q2 share figure and the six month net and share figures for 1996 and 1997 were provided by the company's financial analyst, Sheila Osgood, as they were not contained in the press release.
Full co name is Paxson Communications Corp.
